name: Lê Phin
tagline: Vietnamese coffee, dripped slow through a phin. East 10th Street.
bio: A Vietnamese coffee shop in the East Village. Every cup drips through a phin: iced cà phê sữa đá, pandan lattes, black sesame lattes. We also make coffee gifts and run phin bars for companies.
